title: Texas Roadhouse Holiday Gift Cards

Visit txrhgiftcards.com today to personalize a Texas Roadhouse Gift Card or choose from one of our pre-designed gift cards for your loved ones today!

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is an ordinary holiday advertisement for Texas Roadhouse gift cards, with the title, description, narration, and visible imagery focused on gift-giving. The requested action is to buy or personalize a restaurant gift card through stated Texas Roadhouse locations or websites, which is presented as conventional retail commerce rather than an investment, credential request, prize scheme, or deceptive participation flow. Holiday and Santa-themed visuals, along with restaurant and food references, support the dining-related promotional context.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is ordinary retail promotion of restaurant gift cards, including an invitation to personalize a card and availability through restaurant locations or online.
